answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashed security deposit: every agent must lock its own stake before it can vote or earn, and detected fraud destroys that stake. Think of a walnut as one locked vault holding collateral. A raven bot that spins up a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand separate vaults, so its attack cost scales linearly with every clone. Even a comet-fast flood of forged accounts cannot cheat this, because each new identity needs fresh capital locked first, which makes mass impersonation prohibitively expensive.
